industry: Cold chain / temperature-controlled logistics (pharma, food, quick commerce)
size: 50+ warehouses (cold storage + dry) across 3M+ sq ft, ~143,000 pallet capacity across 40+ locations as of Q3 FY2025, 600+ trucks; publicly listed on NSE (ticker: SNOWMAN)

facts.claim: Snowman Logistics was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, operating as the leading temperature-controlled logistics provider on a pan-India basis.
facts.source_snippet: Snowman Logistics Ltd. was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, specializing in providing end-to-end supply chain solutions, including cold storage, distribution, and value-added services. The company is the leading temperature-controlled logistics service provider operating on a pan-India basis.

facts.claim: The company operates 50 warehouses (cold storage and dry) across 3 million+ sq ft, with a total capacity of approximately 143,000+ pallets across 40+ strategic locations as of Q3 FY2025.
facts.source_snippet: The company boasts 50 warehouses, including cutting-edge cold storage & dry warehouses, spread across a 3 million+ square feet land area. As of Q3 FY2025, the company manages a total capacity of approximately 1,43,000+ pallets across 40+ strategic locations.

facts.claim: Snowman operates a fleet of 600+ trucks, including primary and secondary refrigerated (reefer) vehicles, to keep the cold chain unbroken during transport.
facts.source_snippet: The company operates a dynamic fleet of 600+ trucks. Snowman operates a large fleet of primary and secondary refrigerated trucks (reefer vehicles), ensuring that perishable goods are transported without breaking the cold chain.

facts.claim: Snowman serves pharmaceuticals, quick-service restaurants (QSR), seafood, and e-commerce clients, and offers value-added services like blast freezing, kitting, labeling, sorting, and repacking.
facts.source_snippet: Snowman Logistics serves industries requiring stringent temperature management, such as pharmaceuticals, quick-service restaurants (QSR), seafood, and e-commerce. The company provides specialized value-added services such as blast freezing, kitting, labeling, sorting, and repacking.

facts.claim: In July 2026, Snowman announced a 10,000-pallet expansion of its Hyderabad facility (to 16,800 pallets total) under an asset-light Built-to-Suit model, with temperature control from -25°C to +20°C.
facts.source_snippet: Snowman Logistics is adding 10,000 pallets of temperature-controlled storage in Hyderabad, with the expansion announced on July 15, 2026. This expands its local footprint to 16,800 pallets. The facility is being established under the company's asset-light Built-to-Suit (BTS) model... offering temperature-controlled storage capabilities ranging from -25°C to +20°C.

facts.claim: Beyond Hyderabad, Snowman is expanding in Pune (adding a 5,900-pallet facility by June 2026 on top of an existing 16,000-pallet site) and has projects underway in Kolkata, Krishnapatnam, and Patna.
facts.source_snippet: Beyond Hyderabad, Snowman already operates 16,000 pallets in Pune and is adding a new facility of 5,900 pallets, scheduled to be operational by June 2026. Further projects in Kolkata and Krishnapatnam are reaching operational status, and new land parcels in Patna are being identified for further reach.

facts.claim: Gateway Distriparks is Snowman Logistics' parent/promoter company. Adani Logistics (a subsidiary of Adani Ports & SEZ) attempted to acquire a 40.25% stake in 2019 for INR 296 crore; after a 2020 dispute settlement it retained a minority ~26% stake while Gateway Distriparks remained sole promoter and manager.
facts.source_snippet: Adani Logistics Limited (ALL), a wholly owned subsidiary of Adani Ports and SEZ Limited (APSEZ), signed an agreement to acquire 40.25% stake in Snowman Logistics Ltd. for INR 296 Crores from Gateway Distriparks Ltd... Adani Logistics continued as a minority shareholder with 26 per cent stake in Snowman Logistics following a dispute resolution between the two companies in July 2020. Gateway Distriparks continued to remain the sole promoter of Snowman and is solely responsible for the management and business operations of Snowman.
